cards.subtitle: Deterministic Harald Koschmieder (1924) daylight aerial perspective equation (L(u) = L_obj * (1 - u) + L_sky * u across 17 atmospheric scattering opacity stations u = 1 - exp(-sigma_t * d) in [0.0000, 1.0000], coupling background Beer-Lambert extinction T = 1 - u with in-scattered daylight airlight 1 - T = u to lock normalized horizon equilibrium radiance L/L_sky = (1 - u) + u = 1.0000x with 0/17 distorted stations) versus naive additive airlight haze without background extinction (L_obj + u * L_sky, which inflates horizon radiance as 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x double-bright whiteout at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-slab radiative transfer quadrature.
